cells.Where: Nix build scripts, `bin/ci/background-check.sh`, `bin/ci/resolve-perfetto-bin-dir.sh`, `bin/dice-lsf-runner` (`flake.nix`, `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix`, `bin/dice-lsf-runner` and 6 more files)
cells.What Tron does with it: The Nix build scripts keep their source copy and build tree below it. `bin/ci/background-check.sh` and `bin/ci/resolve-perfetto-bin-dir.sh` put their files below it when `RUNNER_TEMP` is unset or empty. `bin/dice-lsf-runner` replaces an unusable value with `/tmp`.

cells.Where: `make`, `cmake`, `bin/slice`, `bin/bsub-build`, `perfetto/tronperf`, `perfetto/wrapper` (`GNUmakefile`, `CMakePresets.json`, `bin/slice` and 6 more files). Two Nix build scripts set `nixbld`. `bin/dice` sets it for a job in shared Dice mode.
cells.What Tron does with it: `make` and the CMake presets use the ccache directory `/tmp/ccache-<USER>`. `perfetto/tronperf` and `perfetto/wrapper` run `sudo chown` for this user when `/sys/kernel/tracing` is not writable. `bin/slice` sends it to the Dice daemon. `bin/bsub-build` passes it on.

cells.Where: Python `getpass.getuser()` inside `bin/dice`, `bin/slice` and `bin/dice_lsf_view.py`. No Tron file names the variable.
cells.What Tron does with it: `getpass.getuser()` returns it only when `LOGNAME`, `USER` and `LNAME` are all unset or empty. `bin/dice` then names its default runtime directory `/tmp/dice-<name>`.

cells.Where: `bin/slice`, `bin/bsub-build`. Three Nix build scripts and 4 test files set it (`flake.nix`, `nix/model-plugins.nix`, `nix/model-traces.nix` and 4 more files).
cells.What Tron does with it: `bin/slice` stores the downloaded tokenizer vocabulary `o200k_base.tiktoken` under `<value>/tron/tiktoken-encodings/<hash>/`. `bin/bsub-build` exports the same value in the remote build job.

cells.Where: Nothing in Tron. `.github/workflows/gcp-nix.yml`, `bin/ci/test-lint-full-rejection.sh` and `bin/ci/test-nix-fresh-cabal-plan.sh` set it for `nix`.

The step `Free disk space` deletes this directory with `sudo rm -rf`. The same command deletes 4 fixed directories of preinstalled tools.

cells.What Tron does with it: `run-lint-checks.sh` prints `::stop-commands::` and resume lines around the Nix lint build. It prints an `::error` line when the build fails. `build-all.sh` prints `::group::` and `::endgroup::` lines around each model export.

`hf_cache.py` puts it in front of `/repos/<repository>/<path>` for its GitHub API reads. These reads get the current `main` commit and the Git hashes of `bin/ci/prime_hf_models.py` and `bin/ci/hf_cache.py`.

cells.Where: Steps of 6 workflows (`.github/workflows/cmake-single-platform.yml`, `.github/workflows/gcp-nix.yml`, `.github/workflows/cpp-coverage.yml` and 3 more files)
cells.What Tron does with it: Workflow steps append `NAME=value` lines to this file. Later steps of the job then get `NAME` in their environment. `test_runtime.py` and `benchmark_runtime.py` get the path through the option `--github-environment` and append lines too.

On `schedule`, `bench-refresh-ci.sh` limits the measurement timeout to the time left until 30 seconds before the stop time `SLICE_REFRESH_STOP_UTC`. On `workflow_dispatch`, `resolve-apt-channel.sh` takes the apt channel from a non-empty `DISPATCH_CHANNEL`.
